description_zh: 更新直播录制转点播配置
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-record-vod-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testName --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveRecordVodConfig

parameters.help_en: The application name. You can view the `AppName` on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. You can view the `StreamName` on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: <notice>This parameter is ignored if the `RecordFormat` parameter is specified.></notice> The ID of the ApsaraVideo for VOD transcoding template group
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入 RecordFormat 参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
点播转码模板组ID
parameters.name: vod_transcode_group_id

parameters.help_en: The duration of each cyclical recording file, in seconds. Default value: 3600. Valid values: 300 to 21600
parameters.help_zh: 周期录制时长。单位：秒。默认值为3600，取值范围：300~21600
parameters.name: cycle_duration

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is ignored if the `RecordFormat` parameter is specified.></notice>
Specifies whether to enable automatic composition. Valid values:

ON: Enables automatic composition. If you set this value to ON, you must also specify the `ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入 RecordFormat 参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
是否开启自动合并。取值：

ON：开启。如果取值为ON，必须同时设置请求参数ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId
parameters.name: auto_compose

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is ignored if the `RecordFormat` parameter is specified.></notice>
The ID of the ApsaraVideo for VOD transcoding template group used to transcode the video after automatic composition.

You can get the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454928.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入 RecordFormat 参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
对自动合成出来的新视频在点播服务中进行一次转码，所使用的点播转码模板组ID。

通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454928.html 获取
parameters.name: compose_vod_transcode_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The on-demand recording mode. Valid values:

0 (default): Disables on-demand recording.

1: Enables on-demand recording triggered by an HTTP callback.

2: Triggers recording by parsing push streaming parameters.

7: Manual recording. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html operation to start or stop recording
parameters.help_zh:
按需录制，取值：

0（默认值）：关闭。

1：通过HTTP回调方式。

2：通过解析推流参数触发录制。

7：手动录制，默认不录制，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html接口手动控制录制开启或停止
parameters.name: on_demand

parameters.help_en: The maximum duration of a stream interruption, in seconds. If a stream interruption exceeds this duration, the system generates a new file. Valid values: 15 to 21600
parameters.help_zh: 断流拼接时长， 直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持 15~21600 秒
parameters.name: delay_time

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic composition. Valid values:

`ON`: Enables automatic composition.

`OFF`: Disables automatic composition
fields.help_zh:
自动合并，设置为 ON 表示开启自动合并。取值：

ON，开启自动合并

OFF，关闭自动合并
fields.name: auto_compose

fields.help_en:
The video processing method. Valid values:

`transcode`: Processes the video by using a transcoding template group.

`workflow`: Processes the video by using a workflow
fields.help_zh:
视频处理方式。取值：

transcode，使用转码模版组处理视频

workflow，使用工作流处理视频
fields.name: process_method

fields.help_en:
The ID of the transcoding template group or workflow.

## The ID must match the video processing method specified in ProcessMethod. For example, if ProcessMethod is set to transcode, you must use a transcoding template group ID
fields.help_zh:
视频处理转码模版组 Id 或工作流模版 Id
此处传入的 Id 必须与 ProcessMethod 传入的视频处理方式对应，即 ProcessMethod 传入 transcode，此处应使用转码模版组 Id
-
fields.name: process_template_id

fields.help_en:
The duration of each segment, in seconds.
<notice>This parameter applies only to the `m3u8` format.></notice>
The default value is 30. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长，单位：秒
<notice>当 RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为 m3u8 时，本参数才有效。></notice>
不填则默认为 30 秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en:
The video source to process. Valid values:

`origin` (default): Processes the source video.

`compose`: Processes the composed video.

To process both the source and composed videos, separate the values with a comma. For example, `origin,compose`
fields.help_zh:
视频处理源。取值：

origin(默认值)，处理源视频

compose，处理合并后视频

如需同时处理源视频和合并后视频，请将两个取值同时传入,以","分隔，如 origin,compose
fields.name: video_process

parameters.help_en: A list of parameters for each recording format
parameters.help_zh: 按格式配置录制参数列表
parameters.name: record_format
